mentions.name: Codeboards
mentions.description: This app generates a developer portfolio that updates itself automatically from the user's GitHub, StackOverflow, LinkedIn, and other sources, keeping it current without manual maintenance.
mentions.problem: Most developer portfolios are outdated, manual, and painful to maintain; GitHub alone doesn't show who you are, LinkedIn is noise, and personal websites tend to die after 6 months.
mentions.audience: Developers who need an up-to-date portfolio showcasing their work across platforms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built Codeboards, a developer portfolio that updates itself automatically from your GitHub, StackOverflow, LinkedIn, and more.

evidence.value: I built Codeboards, a developer portfolio that updates itself automatically from your GitHub, StackOverflow, LinkedIn, and more.
